design_summary.exp1: 50 deterministic NumPy seeds; two redundant linear pathways; lesion A; compare frozen learning, truthful online adaptation, shuffled-credit adaptation, mechanism-only rescue, full learner-state rollback rescue.
design_summary.exp2: 50 seeds; 5000 update steps; lesion duty cycles 1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1.

interpretation_boundary: The experiment proves only that the confound is possible in a simple adaptive redundant system. It does not establish that Frank exhibits the same magnitude, timescale, or mechanism.
